subject: StackMatch kickoff: coordinating AE + SE + engineering + procurement
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: StackMatch kickoff: coordinating AE + SE + eng + procurement

Hi Alex — great chatting yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute discovery + kickoff with your champion, your engineering lead, and procurement/security so we can: 

- Align scope and success criteria
- Surface any security/compliance blockers (SOC2, retention, VPC)
- Walk through a short tech intake and timeline

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 18: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed Jul 19: 11:00–11:45 or 15:30–16:15

Can you confirm who from your side should attend (champion + eng lead + procurement contact)? Karthik (SE) will run the tech portion and I (AE) will lead. Marissa (manager) is looped for visibility.

Attached: a short kickoff agenda and a draft SOW stub for context.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Kim — quick heads up on attendees:
- I'll be the champion (Alex)
- Priya Rao will be the engineering lead (CC'd)
- Jordan Mills is procurement (I'll intro separately if needed)

Of the times, Wed Jul 19 11:00–11:45 PDT works best for Priya and me. Jordan prefers afternoons but said he can try to join for 11:00 if necessary. Two questions:

1) Will you need any pre-call inventory from Priya (e.g., list of endpoints, data residency constraints)?
2) Do you expect the security person to be an SME from Redwood or should we bring one from our side?

Appreciate the agenda, see you soon.

—Alex
Product Lead, StackMatch

Thanks everyone — I can make the 15:30–16:15 slot on Wed Jul 19. I can also be available for 11:00 if we need to accommodate Jordan's deputy. For the pre-call artifacts, a short network diagram and a list of API endpoints + expected QPS / payload sizes would be ideal. If you can send those, I'll prep a short checklist to speed the meeting.

Security SME: Marissa, would you or someone from our security team be available for the 15:30 slot for a 15-minute block to confirm VPC, data-at-rest, and retention expectations? If not, I can run the high-level answers.

Quick ask list for Priya (pre-call):
- Network diagram (PDF)
- List of endpoints + auth method (CSV or doc)
- Typical QPS and payload size estimates
- Any required compliance docs (SOC2 scope / ISO) if available

I'll send a calendar hold once we lock the time.
